description: This file implements asynchronous Text-To-Speech (TTS) services, including WebSocket-based streaming and HTTP-based streaming options, for integrating with the Async AI TTS API. It defines classes for managing WebSocket connections, sending TTS requests, handling responses, and managing related lifecycle events and metrics.

classes.name: AsyncAITTSService
classes.description: Asynchronous WebSocket-based TTS service supporting streaming text-to-speech synthesis with real-time connections and metrics management.

classes.name: AsyncAIHttpTTSService
classes.description: Asynchronous HTTP-based TTS service providing streaming text-to-speech synthesis via HTTP API, suitable for use where WebSocket connections are unnecessary.

methods.description: Converts a Language enum to its corresponding Async language code string.

methods.description: Initializes the Async WebSocket TTS service with necessary credentials and configuration.

methods.description: Indicates that this service supports metrics generation.

methods.description: Converts a Language enum to the service-specific language code.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService._build_msg
methods.description: Constructs a JSON message for TTS WebSocket communication.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService.start
methods.description: Starts the WebSocket connection and initializes the TTS session.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService.stop
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection and stops the TTS session.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService.cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing TTS streaming and tears down the connection.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService._connect
methods.description: Establishes the WebSocket connection and initializes the session.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService._disconnect
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection and cleans up.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService._connect_websocket
methods.description: Handles setting up the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService._disconnect_websocket
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService._get_websocket
methods.description: Returns the current active WebSocket connection object.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService.flush_audio
methods.description: Sends a flush command to the WebSocket to process remaining audio.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService.push_frame
methods.description: Pushes a frame downstream; handles stopping flags for TTS stop or interruption frames.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService._receive_messages
methods.description: Receives messages from the WebSocket and processes audio or error responses.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService._keepalive_task_handler
methods.description: Periodically sends keepalive messages to maintain the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: AsyncAITTSService.run_tts
methods.description: Performs streaming TTS by sending text over WebSocket and yielding audio frames.

methods.name: AsyncAIHttpTTSService.__init__
methods.description: Initializes HTTP-based TTS service with API credentials and configuration.

methods.name: AsyncAIHttpTTSService.can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates support for metrics generation.

methods.name: AsyncAIHttpTTSService.language_to_service_language
methods.description: Converts a Language enum to a service-specific language code.

methods.name: AsyncAIHttpTTSService.start
methods.description: Prepares the HTTP session for TTS requests, setting sample rate.

methods.name: AsyncAIHttpTTSService.run_tts
methods.description: Performs TTS via HTTP POST request and yields audio data as frames.
